answer: Sybil resistance comes from creating each agent’s signing key inside an enclave and accepting its identity only with a fresh hardware quote binding the key to an approved MRENCLAVE. The measurement identifies enclave code; platform attestation proves genuine hardware, while a registry enforces identity uniqueness. A copied VM cannot reproduce the protected key or forge a quote, so adding identities requires more attested silicon, not virtual duplication—whether an agent is named sable, ferrous, or raven.
